target_customer: Consumers who wanted fraud protection and control over credit card spending
problem: After breaches such as the 2013 Target hack, card numbers were exposed and consumers had little control over merchants and subscriptions.
business_model: Card issuance with interchange share and a portion of debt at scale

founders.name: Aaron Frank
founders.background_notes: Named CEO in TechCrunch and PYMNTS coverage.

founders.name: Matt Rothstein
founders.background_notes: Only founder listed on the YC page. TechCrunch says founders had backgrounds in IT, mobile payments and startups including Boulder-based Simple Energy, without assigning them per person.

founders.name: Andrew Dietrich
founders.background_notes: Named in the January 2015 funding coverage.

exit.reason: Final announced in December 2017 it was shutting down; the team joined Goldman in an acquihire reported in early 2018

competitors.name: Coin
competitors.what: Connected card combining many cards in one

competitors.name: Plastc
competitors.what: Connected card combining many cards in one

competitors.name: Apple Pay
competitors.traction_then: Launched October 2014 per the era; not detailed in source

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed a card program with a bank partner, EMV card issuance and dynamic number generation across web, plugin and mobile apps.

defensibility.rationale: Depended on issuer and bank partners. Big banks and Privacy-style virtual card features could replicate the idea.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Final closed its card in 2017 and Goldman Sachs hired the team in an acquihire reported early 2018.

market_need_then: The 2013 Target breach pushed consumers to want card security, and Final had 37,000 people on its waitlist by January 2015.

branding.domain_note: Used getfinal.com because final.com was owned by others and listed for sale in 2014.

identity.visual_style: Company called itself a design first (build second) company
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct first-person plural, addresses readers as you

branding.brand_signature: Design first positioning and a card with per-merchant numbers
branding.community_and_virality: Reported 35,000 to 37,000 pre-launch signups; Product Hunt presence.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong pre-launch demand and a clear design-led story, but the product shut down in 2017 and the name is generic.

outcome_analysis: Final raised a 1 million dollar seed in January 2015, built a card with per-merchant numbers and launched publicly in June 2017. In December 2017 it announced a shutdown without giving a reason and about a dozen staff joined Goldman Sachs. The reason for the closure is not public, so it is coded as an acquihire and other.
notes: Cause of the 2017 shutdown was searched and not found. The founder letter also names Davis Godbout as co-founder and VP of Product, who is not listed elsewhere. Founders' education and prior employers were not found per person. Seed confirmed by TechCrunch and the company's own announcement.
